chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Ibrahim ibn Ayyub, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja‘far (عليه السلام), who said:

While Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) was upon the pulpit, a snake approached from the direction of one of the doors of the masjid. The people intended to kill it, so Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) sent word that they should refrain, and they refrained. The snake came gliding until it reached the pulpit, then it raised itself and greeted Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام), so Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) indicated to it to stand until he finished his sermon.

When he had finished his sermon, he turned to it and said, 'Who are you?' It said, 'Amr ibn Uthman, your khalifah over the jinn. My father died and instructed me to come to you and seek your view. I have come to you, O Amir al-Mu'minin, so what do you command me with, and what do you see?'

Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) said to him, 'I advise you to have taqwa of Allah, and to return and assume the place of your father among the jinn, for you are my khalifah over them.' He said: So Amr bade farewell to Amir al-Mu'minin and departed, and he was his khalifah over the jinn.
So I said to him, 'May I be made your ransom, does Amr come to you, and is that obligatory upon him?' He said, 'Yes.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, Imam Ali (عليه السلام), addressed here as the authoritative leader
key_terms.الْجِنِّ: the jinn, the unseen beings over whom the visitor said he had been appointed
key_terms.الْمِنْبَرِ: the pulpit from which the sermon was being delivered
key_terms.تَقْوَى اللَّهِ: God-consciousness and piety, the core instruction given by the Imam
key_terms.ثُعْبَانٌ: a snake, the form in which the visitor appeared
key_terms.خَلِيفَتُكَ: your khalifah, meaning your appointed representative or deputy
key_terms.خُطْبَتِهِ: his sermon, which the Imam completed before addressing the visitor

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith show the authority of Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) over the jinn?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that a representative from the jinn came to Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) in the form of a snake and sought his instruction regarding succession among the jinn. It highlights his authority being recognized beyond humankind and shows that his counsel to that representative centered on taqwa and rightful leadership. The report also indicates that the jinn would come to the Imams (عليهم السلام) for guidance in the affairs of their religion.
